description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'makeAnthropicMessagesRequest' that sends a streaming request to the Anthropic API, processing message streams, handling different delta types, and invoking callbacks for UI updates, timing, and usage metrics within a chat application.

methods.name: makeAnthropicMessagesRequest
methods.description: Sends a streaming message request to the Anthropic API, processes streaming events, updates UI via callbacks, handles errors, and supports optional tools and metadata.
